intent: Stormheart Adept: a General Feat with native advancement. A fixed +1 Constitution, two always-prepared spells granted by name with one free casting per long rest, Athletics proficiency and a storm die that scales from 1d6 to 2d6 at level 12.
prerequisite: 5e Item Importer only. The granted spells resolve by name against the installed compendia at import time; with both 2014 and 2024 SRD packs installed each spell is ambiguous and needs a pick in the import window.

intent: Stormheart Field Pack: a container whose CONTENTS create ten days of rations, a hatchet and an oilskin pouch inside it, with flint and steel nested inside the pouch.
prerequisite: 5e Item Importer only. Paste into the import window (the batch flow); the container is created first and each content is placed inside it in the same collection and folder.

intent: A complete native item with two authored activities, shared parent-item charges and a passive ward.
prerequisite: Both importers; equip and attune the weapon to use its passive ward.

intent: Tempest's Oath: five activities, six shared charges, a hidden MIDI save follow-up, an applied prone effect and a passive AC ward.
prerequisite: Both importers and MIDI-QOL. Check module automation settings and token targets. End the prone effect when the creature stands; the catalog has not tested this combat sequence.

intent: Stormheart Legacy: a species feature with a proficiency-bonus use pool shared by a MIDI cone save that applies a deafened effect and a temporary hit point heal, plus a passive resistance effect carrying a MIDI advantage flag.
prerequisite: Both importers and MIDI-QOL. Check module automation settings, template targeting and the deafened effect's turn-end expiry; the catalog has not tested this combat sequence.
